people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out, and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
translations.bsb: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
translations.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
translations.asv: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon him, went forth, and saith unto them, Whom seek ye?
